name: Gold After SPY-TLT Decorrelation: Why 2025-2026 Is Different
description: Decomposes gold's post-flip return after SPY-TLT 60-day correlation crosses from positive to negative. At each decorrelation event, captures: (1) GLD secular trend (trailing 252d return), (2) real rate proxy (TIP/TLT ratio 63d rate of change), (3) dollar direction (UUP 63d return), (4) macro stress (VIX level). Scatter shows GLD 20d forward return vs trailing 252d return at each flip, revealing why recent 2025-2026 flips produced stronger gold rallies. Summary table compares early-period vs 2025-2026 events across all four dimensions.
source:
# Gold After SPY-TLT Decorrelation: Why 2025-2026 Is Different
# Signal: 60d rolling correlation of SPY vs TLT returns crosses below zero
# Decomposition: secular trend, real rates, dollar, macro stress

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
gld_close = src.c

spy = common_reference_stocks(ticker=ReferenceStock.SPY)()
tlt = common_reference_stocks(ticker=ReferenceStock.TLT)()
tip = reference_stocks(ticker='TIP')()
uup = reference_stocks(ticker='UUP')()
vix = common_indices(ticker=ReferenceIndex.VIX)()

# Forward-fill reference data to handle calendar misalignment
spy_c = ffill(spy.c)
tlt_c = ffill(tlt.c)
tip_c = ffill(tip.c)
uup_c = ffill(uup.c)
vix_c = ffill(vix.c)

# --- SPY-TLT Correlation Signal ---
spy_ret = returns(period=1)(spy_c)
tlt_ret = returns(period=1)(tlt_c)
corr_60 = rolling_corr(window=60)(spy_ret, tlt_ret)

# Detect positive-to-negative flip (decorrelation event)
is_flip = crossunder(corr_60, 0)

# --- GLD Decomposition Components ---
# 1. Secular trend: trailing 252d return (1-year momentum)
gld_trend_252d = returns(period=252)(gld_close)

# 2. Real rate proxy: TIP/TLT ratio change (rising = falling real rates = gold bullish)
tip_tlt_ratio = tip_c / tlt_c
tip_tlt_roc_63d = roc(period=63)(tip_tlt_ratio)

# 3. Dollar direction: UUP trailing 63d return
uup_ret_63d = returns(period=63)(uup_c)

# 4. Macro stress: VIX level at flip (vix_c already forward-filled)

# --- Forward Returns ---
gld_fwd_20d = forward_returns(period=20)(gld_close)

# --- Values at Flip Events ---
flip_fwd_20d = where(is_flip, gld_fwd_20d)
flip_trend_252d = where(is_flip, gld_trend_252d)
flip_tip_tlt = where(is_flip, tip_tlt_roc_63d)
flip_uup = where(is_flip, uup_ret_63d)
flip_vix = where(is_flip, vix_c)

# --- Era Classification ---
ts = index().value
yr = datetime_extract()(ts)
is_recent = yr >= 2025

# --- Output 1: Rolling Correlation Over Time with Flip Context ---
# Question: "When did stocks and bonds decouple?"
xy_lines(
    title='When Did Stocks and Bonds Decouple?',
    y_axis_label='60d Rolling Correlation',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='',
    category='Gold Decorrelation',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SPY-TLT Correlation', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(color=Color.Red, opacity=0.08, label='Negative Corr', from=-1.0, to=0.0)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(corr_60,))

# --- Output 2: Scatter — GLD 20d Fwd Return vs Trailing 252d Return at Flips ---
# Question: "Does a stronger secular trend explain why recent flips produced bigger gold rallies?"
xy_scatter(
    title='Stronger Gold Trend = Bigger Post-Flip Rally?',
    x_axis_label='GLD Trailing 252d Return at Flip',
    y_axis_label='GLD 20d Forward Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    category='Gold Decorrelation',
    show_trend_line=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero Return')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x=flip_trend_252d, y_values=(flip_fwd_20d,))

# --- Output 3: Summary Table — Early vs 2025-2026 Decomposition ---
early_fwd = where(is_valid(flip_fwd_20d) and not is_recent, flip_fwd_20d)
recent_fwd = where(is_valid(flip_fwd_20d) and is_recent, flip_fwd_20d)
early_trend = where(is_valid(flip_trend_252d) and not is_recent, flip_trend_252d)
recent_trend = where(is_valid(flip_trend_252d) and is_recent, flip_trend_252d)
early_tip_tlt = where(is_valid(flip_tip_tlt) and not is_recent, flip_tip_tlt)
recent_tip_tlt = where(is_valid(flip_tip_tlt) and is_recent, flip_tip_tlt)
early_uup = where(is_valid(flip_uup) and not is_recent, flip_uup)
recent_uup = where(is_valid(flip_uup) and is_recent, flip_uup)
early_vix = where(is_valid(flip_vix) and not is_recent, flip_vix)
recent_vix = where(is_valid(flip_vix) and is_recent, flip_vix)

summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Why 2025-2026 Flips Are Different',
        row_size=5, col_size=4,
        row_headers=['GLD 20d Fwd Return (Median)', 'GLD 252d Trailing Ret (Median)', 'TIP/TLT 63d RoC (Median)', 'UUP 63d Return (Median)', 'VIX at Flip (Median)'],
        col_headers=['Earlier', '2025-2026', 'Earlier (N)', '2025-2026 (N)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='Gold Decorrelation',
    order=2
)(early_fwd, recent_fwd, early_fwd, recent_fwd,
  early_trend, recent_trend, early_trend, recent_trend,
  early_tip_tlt, recent_tip_tlt, early_tip_tlt, recent_tip_tlt,
  early_uup, recent_uup, early_uup, recent_uup,
  early_vix, recent_vix, early_vix, recent_vix)

# --- Event Markers: Each Decorrelation Flip ---
flip_era = conditional_select(is_flip and is_recent, "2025-2026",
                               is_flip and not is_recent, "Earlier",
                               "N/A")

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='SPY-TLT Decorrelation Flip',
        icon=Icon.ShuffleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Era', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='GLD 20d Fwd Return', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='GLD 252d Trend', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='VIX', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='UUP 63d Ret', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='TIP/TLT 63d RoC', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(flip_era, gld_fwd_20d, gld_trend_252d, vix_c, uup_ret_63d, tip_tlt_roc_63d, is_flip)
